verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own docs say Computer can connect to 400+ services through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth, so adding third-party connectors is documented. Nothing shows a browsable directory or app marketplace, and the claim is a single line on the Computer MCP server page. missing for 10: a documented browsable connector/app directory, details of how users discover and add connectors in the assistant UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: **Connect to 400+ services** through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth
